answer: Cheap throwaway accounts can't fake that chain, so forging one costs a full bond plus the wasted epoch. Each agent must stake a bond held in a shared vault, and every epoch it posts a signed anchor linking its identity to prior work history. A sparrow-sized stake still deters mass registration, because a thousand fakes would lock a thousand bonds before earning a single attestation. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
